question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

YPP -1 VRM -3 ? PVG -27 MXD -81
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ed9dd03d43e7aa677b89db86b67aed3147aa8ab37214c3b98c0a1868b05130e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68caf60b8146beb062bbc73f90a8e9ac9067a323ce0da936d48e16ab73bf8158.png] 

So,** 'STJ -9' **will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
